guia.what: A single-line text field. Supports a label, hint, error, prefixes and suffixes, a character counter, and a clear button (`data-ts-clear`).
whenUse: Capturing short, single-line text, like a name, email, search query, or code.
You need a prefix or suffix (a unit, an icon) or a clear button.
Use `type` to switch to email, password, or tel and get the right system keyboard.
whenAvoid: The text can be long or span several lines → `textarea`.
It’s a number with limits and a step → `number-input`.
dos: Build it with the `field` markup for the label and messages.
Pick the right `type`. It improves the mobile keyboard and validation.
donts: Don’t use the placeholder as a label.
Don’t use it to choose from a closed set → `select`.

nucleo: It’s a native `<input>`, plus its own clear button. Keeps the field in sync. On init, the caret of every field with a value moves to the end, so `element.focus()` from code doesn’t type before the existing text. Tab (which selects everything) and clicking work as usual.
